# Orient Global Flagship - Complete Knowledge Base & Restaurant Menu

## About
Orient Global Flagship is a flagship luxury destination at Amada Plaza, Rayfield, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. 
It integrates six premier divisions: Fine Dining Restaurant, Artisanal Bakery, Gourmet Supermarket, Esports Arena, Atmospheric Water & Wellness, and VIP Lounge & Cellar.

## Location & Operating Hours
- **Address:** Amada Plaza, Rayfield, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria
- **Operating Hours:** Open Daily, 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM West Africa Time (WAT)
- **Features:** Dine-in, Private VIP Dining Rooms, Contactless Table Ordering, Fast Rayfield Delivery, Curbside Pickup

---

## Restaurant Menu (Orient Fine Dining)

### 1. Proteins & Grills
- **Peppered & Grilled Beef** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Succulent cuts of prime beef, fried and tossed in spicy habanero, bell pepper, and caramelized onion relish.
  *Ingredients:* Prime Beef, Scotch Bonnet, Bell Peppers, Onions, Local Spices, Garlic.
- **Spiced Roasted & Fried Chicken** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Crispy skin, tender juicy chicken steeped in ginger, garlic, and yaji herbs, roasted to golden perfection.
  *Ingredients:* Farm Fresh Chicken, Yaji Herb Marinade, Paprika, Thyme, Garlic.
- **Peppered Pork Chops** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Thick-cut pork chops seared over hot coals and tossed in a fiery, sweet-and-savory habanero glaze.
  *Ingredients:* Pork Chops, Cameroon Pepper, Scotch Bonnet, Honey Glaze, Rosemary.
- **Goat Meat & Fresh Catfish Platter** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Tender fire-charred chevon (goat meat asun) and fresh point-and-kill river catfish seasoned with local aromatics and yaji spice.
  *Ingredients:* Fresh Catfish, Grass-fed Goat Meat, Yaji Seasoning, Scent Leaves, Lime.

### 2. The Rice Core
- **Smoky Jollof Rice** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Authentic wood-fired party jollof rice cooked in rich reduction of roasted bell peppers, plum tomatoes, and bay leaves.
  *Ingredients:* Long Grain Rice, Plum Tomatoes, Habanero, Bell Peppers, Bay Leaves, Rich Stock.
- **Nigerian Fried Rice** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with sweet carrots, green peas, sweet corn, liver tidbits, and fresh herbs.
  *Ingredients:* Basmati Rice, Diced Liver, Sweet Corn, Carrots, Green Peas, Curry, Thyme.
- **White Rice & Ayamase (Ofada Sauce)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Steamed white rice accompanied by designer bleached palm oil green habanero stew, locust beans (iru), and diced assorted meats.
  *Ingredients:* White Rice, Green Tatashe, Scotch Bonnet, Iru, Assorted Offal, Bleached Palm Oil.
- **Coconut Rice** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Parboiled rice gently simmered in fresh pressed coconut milk, smoked dry fish flakes, and subtle native peppers.
  *Ingredients:* Rice, Pure Coconut Milk, Smoked Fish, Crayfish, Chili Pepper, Stock.

### 3. Soups & Natural Swallows
- **Heritage Egusi Soup** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Ground melon seeds slow cooked in red palm oil broth with fluted pumpkin (ugu) leaves, stockfish, and smoked crayfish.
  *Ingredients:* Melon Seeds (Egusi), Ugu Leaves, Palm Oil, Stockfish, Crayfish, Dry Fish.
- **Efo Riro (Rich Spinach Pottage)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Traditional Yoruba leafy vegetable soup simmered in reduced bell pepper base with shaki, ponmo, dried prawns, and iru.
  *Ingredients:* Shoko/Spinach, Tatashe, Scotch Bonnet, Ponmo, Shaki, Crayfish, Iru.
- **Seafood Okra Soup** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Crisp sliced okra cooked with fresh tiger prawns, blue swimming crabs, calamari rings, and scent leaves in aromatic broth.
  *Ingredients:* Fresh Okra, Jumbo Prawns, Fresh Crab, Calamari, Scent Leaf, Native Herbs.
- **Ogbono & Afang Soup Duet** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Silky bush mango seed draw soup paired with wild Calabar Afang leaves, smoked dry fish, and rich beef broth.
  *Ingredients:* Wild Bush Mango Seeds (Ogbono), Afang Leaves, Water Leaves, Dry Fish, Beef Broth.
- **Fluffy Pounded Yam** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Silky smooth, hot pounded white yam prepared to velvety elastic perfection, ready for dipping into rich heritage soups.
  *Ingredients:* Pure White Yam Tubers, Spring Water.
- **Natural Grain Flours (Amala, Eba & Semo)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Choice of artisanal brown yam flour (Àmàlà Isu), yellow Ijebu cassava gari (Ẹ̀bà), or stone-ground wheat semo.
  *Ingredients:* Dried Yam Flour / Fermented Cassava / Durum Wheat Semolina.

### 4. Yam & Pasta
- **Asaro (Yam Porridge)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Tender white puna yam cubes cooked in palm oil, pepper reduction, dried fish bits, and fresh scent leaves.
  *Ingredients:* Puna Yam, Palm Oil, Dry Fish Chunks, Scotch Bonnet, Scent Leaves.
- **Jollof Spaghetti & Stir-Fry Pasta** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Al dente pasta simmered in rich spiced tomato sauce with bell pepper strips, sweet onions, frankfurters, and herb seasoning.
  *Ingredients:* Italian Pasta, Plum Tomatoes, Tatashe, Onion Rings, Beef Sausage, Thyme.
- **Fried Yam & Plantain Combo** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Golden crispy puna yam sticks served with caramelized sweet plantain dodo and spicy ata dindin dipping relish.
  *Ingredients:* Sweet Yam, Ripe Plantain, Pure Vegetable Oil, Coarse Salt, Ata Dindin Sauce.

### 5. Starters & Sides
- **Artisanal Moi Moi Elewe** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Steamed bean pudding wrapped in aromatic broad thaumatococcus leaves with boiled egg quarters and flaked mackerel.
  *Ingredients:* Black-Eyed Peas, Tatashe, Boiled Eggs, Smoked Mackerel, Crayfish, Leaf Wrap.
- **Fried Plantain (Dodo Platter)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Thick, golden-caramelized ripe plantain discs sprinkled with a pinch of sea salt.
  *Ingredients:* Fresh Ripe Plantains, Sunflower Oil, Sea Salt.
- **Pepper Soup (Catfish & Goat Meat)** (Price: ₦10, Prep Time: 11 mins)
  *Description:* Intensely aromatic broth infused with alligator pepper, calabash nutmeg (ehuru), uda pods, and fresh scent leaves.
  *Ingredients:* Point-and-kill Fresh Catfish or Goat Meat, Ehuru, Uda, Alligator Pepper, Scent Leaf.

## Artisanal Bakery Menu
- **Rustic Sourdough Boule** (Price: ₦10) - 48h cold fermentation, wild Jos highland yeast, crisp caramelized crust.
- **Butter Croissant** (Price: ₦10) - 27 delicate layers of pure French Normandy butter.
- **Pain au Chocolat** (Price: ₦10) - Double batons of 70% dark Belgian chocolate in flaky croissant dough.
- **Forest Berry Tart** (Price: ₦10) - Sweet almond shortcrust with Madagascar vanilla bean pastry cream and fresh mountain berries.
- **NYC Honey Sesame Bagel** (Price: ₦10) - Boiled in honey water before hearth baking.
